'''Kifar Itran''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Itran operated under cover aboard the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].
